topic: Database options and AI agent development
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: database infrastructure and the development of an AI agent.

**Database Infrastructure:** [me] provided information regarding ClickHouse Cloud as a potential solution for data loading, noting that minimal setups are inexpensive (around $200/month) but lack Private Networking. More advanced plans with Private Networking are significantly more costly. Links were shared detailing cost estimates and general availability of bringing your own cloud on AWS.

**AI Agent Development:** [me] confirmed the ability to implement an AI agent by the end of the week for internal testing and critique. The scope of this agent is extensive, including handling complex integrations (e.g., user rights scoping via impersonation), maintaining chat history linked to primary emails, ensuring timely index updates, implementing system prompts for security, and adding advanced features like voice input, self-correction, data extraction, chart generation in the dialogue stream, and fine-tuning of base models.
decisions: AI agent development will proceed for internal testing by the end of the week.
